title: Privacy Policy
html:
1. About this policy

Physics HQ (https://physicshq.in) is a free educational platform created by S. Pradaap Kumar. It offers learning and examination-practice resources including Cambridge IGCSE Physics (0625), AS & A Level Physics (9702), and additional curricula where available. This policy explains how personal information is handled when you browse the site, create an account, use study tools, or contact us.

We aim to collect only what is reasonably needed to operate the service, support learning, secure accounts, and respond to users. This policy should be read together with our Terms & Conditions and Cookie & Local Storage Policy.

2. Information we handle

Account and login information. If you register, our authentication system processes your email address, account identifier, authentication credentials, email confirmation, login sessions, and account-related technical records. Your password is handled by our authentication provider and should not be sent to us by email.

Profile information. Your profile can include a full name, display name, account type (student or teacher), selected grade (IGCSE, AS Level or A Level), school and country. Certain profile fields are optional or can be edited by you.

Learning activity. When you practice, the service may record your selected papers or topics, scores, completed attempts, question-level correct/incorrect outcomes, time spent, saved results, progress and related learning history. Some progress is retained in your browser, and signed-in progress may also be synchronized with your account.

Device and usage information. We and our infrastructure and performance providers may receive technical information such as browser characteristics, IP address, page requests, error or security logs, and aggregated website usage and speed measurements.

Preferences and study tools. Your device may store preferences and study-tool data, for example theme, progress history or a locally saved timetable, depending on the feature used.

Support correspondence. If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to include in your message.

We do not ask for payment details to use Physics HQ because the service is currently free.

3. Why the information is used

We use this information for the purposes of providing accounts, login and security; presenting grade-appropriate learning resources; saving and displaying your study progress; enabling study tools; troubleshooting and measuring service reliability; addressing questions or complaints; preventing abuse; and meeting applicable legal duties. Where consent is legally required, the relevant processing must have the appropriate consent or another permitted legal basis.

4. Students under 18

Our resources are used by students, including students under 18. Parents and guardians should review this policy with younger students and help them use account features safely.

Indian law establishes special requirements for handling children's personal data, including verifiable parental consent in circumstances where it applies. Physics HQ must apply the required age and consent safeguards as the applicable provisions commence and subject to any lawful exemptions. This policy is not evidence that a parental-verification flow is already active.

We do not intend to use children's personal data for targeted advertising or prohibited behavioural tracking. Parents or guardians may contact us about an account or a privacy request. We may need reasonable evidence of their authority before acting.

5. Providers and where data is processed

The website uses Lovable Cloud services for account authentication and application data and Vercel for website hosting and performance/usage tools, including Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights. Other infrastructure or storage providers may be involved depending on the deployed configuration. These services process information needed to supply their features. Their service locations and access arrangements must be checked against the production configuration; data may be processed outside India where lawful.

We do not sell student profiles. Personal information may be made available to infrastructure providers where needed to operate the site, and may be disclosed when legally required or when necessary to protect users and the service, subject to applicable law.

6. Cookies and local storage

Physics HQ uses browser-based technologies for sessions, preferences and learning history. Website usage and performance monitoring may be collected by Vercel tools. Please see our Cookie & Local Storage Policy for the categories of technologies and available controls. Essential storage may be necessary for login or progress features.

7. Security

Account access is handled through authentication systems. We take reasonable steps to protect student records and limit access to appropriate services and administrators. Nevertheless, no online service is risk-free. Do not share passwords. Contact us if you suspect unauthorized use of your account.

8. Retention and deletion

Account and learning information is kept for as long as needed to provide the relevant features, maintain security, deal with legitimate requests, or satisfy applicable obligations. The actual retention periods for platform logs, backups and support messages depend on the underlying service settings and must be confirmed.

Signed-in users can request account deletion through Profile → Delete account. That feature is designed to remove the account and linked learning data. Separately stored browser information, backups or records subject to lawful retention may require additional handling. If you need help with deletion, write to the contact address below.

9. Your choices and privacy requests

You can edit profile information within your account, stop using optional features, clear browser-held data using your browser controls, and request access, correction, updating, erasure or withdrawal of consent as allowed by applicable law. Deletion or withdrawal may make account-based features unavailable. Parents and lawful guardians may make eligible requests on behalf of a child.

For requests or complaints, contact {{contactEmail}}. We may need to verify that the request relates to the correct account. We will respond within applicable legal timeframes.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this notice when our services or legal requirements change. An updated effective date will appear here, and additional notice or consent will be sought when required.

11. Contact

title: Terms & Conditions
html:
1. Agreement

Welcome to Physics HQ (https://physicshq.in), a free educational resource website created by S. Pradaap Kumar. These Terms govern use of our website, accounts, examination-practice tools, explanations and related services. By using the website, you agree to these Terms to the extent permitted by law. Please also read our Privacy Policy.

2. Our educational service

Physics HQ provides Physics resources for students and teachers, including IGCSE (0625), AS & A Level (9702), and other curricula where offered. Features may include MCQ papers, topic-based practice, theory materials, study tools, generated worksheets, performance tracking and explanations. Public study tools may be available without registering; account features may require a login.

The website is currently free. We do not charge subscription or access fees under these Terms. Any future paid offering would require appropriate advance information and updated terms.

3. Accounts and age-appropriate access

Users must provide accurate information and keep their login credentials secure. Do not share passwords or access another person's account without authorization. Account holders should report suspected misuse promptly.

Users under 18 should review these Terms and the Privacy Policy with a parent or lawful guardian. Where law requires parental verification or consent, account processing must meet the applicable requirements. We may limit account access if required safeguards or permissions are absent.

4. Acceptable use

Use Physics HQ for lawful educational activities. You must not attempt to break into accounts or systems; upload malware; interfere with service availability; impersonate another person; misuse other users' information; collect site data by abusive automation; circumvent access controls; or reproduce or distribute protected material without rights or permission.

5. Educational content and accuracy

We work to provide clear and useful Physics resources, but questions, worked solutions, timings, syllabus links, diagrams, calculations, grade estimates and explanatory material can contain mistakes or become outdated. Always check official published syllabuses and examination-board material when accuracy is critical. Practice results and grade estimates are educational aids, not official examination results or grade guarantees.

If you find an error, contact {{contactEmail}} with the relevant page, question or paper reference.

6. Copyright and exam-board materials

Original Physics HQ text, website design and independently produced materials may be protected by copyright. Third-party questions, exam papers, marking schemes, graphics, names and trademarks remain owned by their rights holders. Access to a resource on Physics HQ does not grant permission to copy, redistribute, republish or commercially exploit it.

Physics HQ does not claim copyright ownership of Cambridge International examination papers or mark schemes. Content that cannot lawfully be hosted or shared may be removed or replaced by links to authorized resources. Rights holders can use our Copyright & Takedown Policy.

7. Independence from examination boards

Physics HQ is an independent educational platform. It is not endorsed, sponsored, approved by or affiliated with Cambridge International Education, the International Baccalaureate Organization, CBSE or other examination bodies unless a specific written authorization is expressly identified. Qualification names are used only to describe the relevant learning context.

8. Your submissions and feedback

If you send feedback or educational material, please ensure it is lawful and that you have the required permissions. We may use error reports and suggestions to improve the service, while handling any personal information under our Privacy Policy. Sending feedback does not give us ownership of your pre-existing intellectual property.

9. Access, changes and account closure

We may correct errors, remove resources, modify features or temporarily interrupt access for technical, security or legal reasons. Accounts may be restricted after serious misuse, subject to applicable law. Users can request closure and deletion using Profile → Delete account or by contacting {{contactEmail}}.

10. Third-party links

Some resources may link to sites operated by examination bodies, publishers or other organizations. Those websites are governed by their own rules and privacy practices. A link is not an endorsement or a grant of permission to reproduce their materials.

11. Responsibility and legal rights

Physics HQ is provided for educational assistance. We cannot promise uninterrupted service, error-free content or particular examination outcomes. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control or by unlawful use of the service. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

12. Governing law

These Terms are governed by applicable laws of India. Disputes are subject to courts and processes having jurisdiction under applicable law; this clause does not override mandatory consumer protections or other legal rights.

13. Updates and contact

Material updates will be posted with a revised effective date, with additional notice where required. Questions can be sent to {{contactEmail}}.

title: Copyright & Takedown Policy
html:
1. Our approach

Physics HQ respects the intellectual property rights of educational publishers, examination boards, teachers and creators. This policy explains how to report material you believe is used without permission.

2. Original and third-party work

Original explanations, independently created practice resources, software and designs may belong to Physics HQ or its licensors. Third-party examination questions, papers, mark schemes, examiner reports, diagrams, publications and logos remain owned by their respective rights holders. Naming an examination board does not transfer or imply permission to reproduce its work.

3. Cambridge and other exam materials

Cambridge International has published restrictions on reproducing examination papers, questions and marking material on websites. Physics HQ does not claim that free educational access creates a license, or that an educational disclaimer makes unauthorized publication permissible.

Where a particular resource cannot lawfully be distributed by Physics HQ, it should be removed, replaced with independently written material, or linked to a rights holder's authorized source. Any resource included under permission or another legal basis remains subject to its specific restrictions.

4. Permitted use by visitors

You may use resources in ways allowed by applicable law and any particular resource license. Do not assume that downloading, printing, reposting, scraping, selling or sharing copyrighted third-party material is authorized just because you can view it on Physics HQ.

5. How to report a concern

Contact {{contactEmail}} with the subject Copyright complaint – Physics HQ and, if possible, include:

  • Your name and a way to contact you.
  • The work that you own or represent and your authority to act.
  • The exact Physics HQ page URL or the paper/question identifier.
  • Why you believe the material is used without authorization.
  • Any relevant evidence or rights information.

We may ask for clarification where necessary to evaluate the complaint.

6. Our response

We will review reasonably detailed notices and take action as appropriate, including restricting access, correcting attribution or removing content. We may act immediately when circumstances require it, and we may restore content if a complaint is resolved and publication is lawful. We do not promise that every submitted claim will result in removal.

7. Contact

title: Educational Disclaimer
html:
1. Purpose

Physics HQ is an independent educational platform created by S. Pradaap Kumar. Its resources are intended to support learning, practice, revision and teaching in Physics, including IGCSE, AS & A Level, and other curricula shown on the site.

2. No official affiliation

Physics HQ is not affiliated with, approved by, endorsed by or sponsored by Cambridge International Education, the International Baccalaureate Organization, CBSE or other examination boards unless a particular partnership is expressly identified and authorized. Exam-board names and syllabus codes are used for educational identification only.

3. Educational accuracy

We aim to provide accurate explanations, diagrams, calculations and practice resources. Mistakes and outdated information are still possible, particularly when syllabuses, exam formats and grading conventions change. Official examination-board syllabuses, notices, examination papers and marking guidance take precedence over any conflicting explanation on Physics HQ.

4. Practice scores and grade estimates

Scores, practice results, performance analytics, difficulty indications, topic mastery and grade-boundary estimates are informational learning aids. They are not official grades, certifications or predictions guaranteed to match an actual examination. Students are responsible for their own preparation and should confirm current exam requirements with their school or examination board.

5. External materials

Third-party content and intellectual property remain subject to their owners' rights. References or links do not imply licensing, endorsement or permission for reproduction.

6. Report a problem

We welcome corrections. Send the page URL, syllabus/paper reference and a description of the issue to {{contactEmail}}.

title: Cookie & Local Storage Policy
html:
1. Browser technologies

Physics HQ uses cookies or similar browser storage and technical tools to support login, remember preferences, retain learning progress and understand whether the website is working reliably. Some tools use local storage rather than traditional cookies.

2. Technologies used on Physics HQ

Authentication and account sessions: Lovable Cloud authentication and related browser storage help maintain signed-in sessions and support secure account access.

Preferences and study progress: Your device may save your theme selection, selected grade, locally recorded practice attempts, scores and other supported study-tool settings. Signed-in results may also be synchronized to the account database.

Website analytics and performance: The application includes Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to help understand page usage and website performance. These services may process technical request and usage data in accordance with their configurations and provider terms.

Technical operations: Hosting infrastructure may use technical records or request identifiers to maintain site availability and protect against abuse.

A current inventory of the exact cookies, storage keys, providers and retention periods should be maintained from the deployed site's configuration.

3. Children's privacy and advertising

We do not intend to use children's data for targeted advertising or prohibited behavioural tracking. Website analytics must be configured and operated consistently with applicable child-data requirements. We do not offer advertising-based personalized accounts as part of the current free educational service.

4. Your controls

Most browsers allow you to inspect, clear or block cookies and local storage. Clearing browser storage may sign you out, remove locally saved progress or reset preferences. For signed-in account records, use your profile features or contact our privacy team as described in the Privacy Policy.

If optional, non-essential technologies requiring consent are introduced, the relevant notice and choices must be presented when required by law.

5. Changes and contact

We may update this page as website features or technology providers change. Questions can be sent to {{contactEmail}}.

title: Parent & Guardian Privacy Notice
html:
Physics HQ provides free Physics learning resources, and some users may be under 18 years old. Some public resources can be accessed without registering. An account supports profile settings, learning-progress synchronization and practice history.

What information may be involved?

When a student registers, information can include an email address, account identifier, login details and an optional profile with name, grade, school and country. Practice features may create scores, question-level results, timings and other progress records. Limited technical data is processed for the service to operate securely. Please read our full Privacy Policy and Cookie & Local Storage Policy.

How information is used

The main purposes are to authenticate the student, provide learning resources, save progress, support study activities, answer questions and protect the service. Physics HQ is currently free and does not require payment information.

Children and permission

Where applicable Indian law or other relevant law requires verifiable parental consent before processing a child's personal data, Physics HQ must obtain it using an appropriate method before enabling the relevant processing, unless an applicable legal exemption applies. Merely ticking a box that says a student has permission does not by itself establish verifiable consent.

Parents and lawful guardians should review the Privacy Policy and may contact {{contactEmail}} to ask questions or make eligible requests concerning a child.

Questions and requests from parents

For a question or request about a student's account, email {{contactEmail}} with the account email and a short description of what you need. Please do not send passwords or unnecessary identity documents. We may ask for reasonable information to establish your identity and authority before providing account information or acting on a request.

About consent verification

This notice explains our approach; reading it does not collect or verify parental consent. Where applicable law requires verification, an appropriate consent process must be completed before the relevant processing, unless a lawful exemption applies.
